title: feat(app-shell): pre-warm the prod env from the Cloud onboarding widget
body:
Part of the ObjectOS Cloud **console IA program** (app-first landing). Companion cloud PR adds the backend warm route + wires the Welcome page.

## What

`CloudOnboardingNext` (the `cloud:onboarding-next` SDUI widget on the Cloud Welcome page) already fetches whether the caller has a production env, to choose Open-vs-Create. This PR: when the env exists **and the page passes a new `warmUrl`**, fire a best-effort `GET warmUrl` the instant we know — pre-warming a possibly-asleep container while the user reads the hint, so the "Open Production" click seconds later lands in an already-waking env instead of the full cold-start.

- Folded into the existing entitlements effect — no extra decision round-trip.
- Fire-and-forget, best-effort, once per resolve; the sso-open click warms again anyway, so a failed warm here costs nothing.
- **No-op when `warmUrl` is unset** → safe to merge ahead of the cloud page metadata + backend route.

## Why

The IA program turns the Welcome page into a workspace landing pad whose primary action is "enter your workspace". Cold-start is the wait behind that action (CF containers + kernel TTL sleep); pre-warming on landing removes it for the common case.

## Verify

`turbo build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell` green (tsc). Behavior is exercised end-to-end once the cloud PR bumps `.objectui-sha` and passes `warmUrl` — no visible change until then (no-op path).
